coaching_note: Skip the quid pro quo framing entirely, never ask for their biggest concerns, skip the Two Promises guarantees, and never ask for the business explicitly—this call skipped all four of those load-bearing items; focus on rebuilding Section 1 (time-boxed ask + dependable quote promise + wait for yes), Section 2 (Their Agenda before any probing), and Section 7 (explicit close with the Two Promises already covered).
